sessions.text:
User: I'm going to hand you a lot of small Python snippets this month.
Assistant: Happy to help. Any defaults I should follow?
User: I prefer minimal comments, only where the code isn't obvious. Also, always end your answers with a one-line TL;DR.
Assistant: Noted. Sparse comments, and a one-line TL;DR at the end of each answer.
User: Thanks, that's it for now.

User: I need the sales rollup script written up for our new intern.
Assistant: Sure. How should I tailor it for them?
User: Just for this one, comment every step in detail, because the intern is new to Python.
Assistant: Understood. I'll comment every step of the sales rollup script in detail.
User: Great. We'll pick the job up again later.
